<div class="page-intro">
Our group brings together researchers working across geospatial data science, climate adaptation, urban analytics, conservation, and participatory environmental decision-making.
</div>

## Principal Investigator
<div class="card-grid"><div class="person-card director-card" style="grid-column: span 12;"><img class="person-photo" src="https://www.pivot-model.com/static/img/avatars/derek.jpg" alt="Derek Van Berkel"><div><h3>Derek Van Berkel, PhD</h3><div class="person-role">Associate Professor · School for Environment and Sustainability · University of Michigan</div><p>Derek is a geographer and geospatial data scientist whose research examines climate adaptation and migration, urban and landscape change, participatory mapping, conservation, and environmental decision-making. He is Principal Investigator of GLISA, CLARS, and CHIRRP/PUMP-COR.</p><p><strong>Research interests:</strong> geospatial data science · climate adaptation · GeoAI · participatory GIS · landscape change · conservation</p><p>In 2026, he is a <strong>North America Visiting Fellow at the University of Helsinki</strong>, hosted by Prof. Enrico Di Minin.</p><p class="person-meta"><a href="mailto:dbvanber@umich.edu">Email</a> · <a href="/files/Derek_Van_Berkel_CV.pdf">CV</a> · <a href="https://github.com/DerekVanBerkel">GitHub</a> · <a href="https://seas.umich.edu/research/faculty/derek-van-berkel">SEAS profile</a></p></div></div></div>
